source.name: Wikipedia (en), 'Castore' (kit-making deals section)
source.quote: Starting in the 2023–24 football season, Feyenoord announced that they will leave Adidas after 9 years for Castore
source.note: Kit-maker deal, recorded for the partnership start. No verified monetary value: press reports of a figure were not retrievable (AD.nl and RTV Rijnmond articles are behind paywalls/blocks with no Wayback snapshot), so value is left null rather than invented.

note: Castore became Feyenoord's kit maker from season 2023-24 and produces the 2026-27 home kit.
